name: Edge time series
summary: Computes edge time series (element-wise products of z-scored regional time series for every region pair) from regional fMRI time series.
description: Z-scores each regional fMRI time series and multiplies every pair of regions frame by frame, giving one edge time series per region pair (upper triangle). Use it for edge-centric functional connectivity analyses; the time average of the edge time series equals the Pearson correlation. The README says the output is an HTML report, but the code writes a compressed TSV of edge time series with a JSON of region-pair names.

inputs.description: Regional fMRI time series as a TSV (time points in rows, regions in columns) with its JSON sidecar.

outputs.description: Edge time series (timeseries.tsv.gz, one column per region pair) and timeseries.json naming each pair.

citations.text: Faskowitz J, Esfahlani FZ, Jo Y, Sporns O, Betzel RF. Edge-centric functional network representations of human cerebral cortex reveal overlapping system-level architecture. Nat Neurosci 23(12):1644-1654 (2020).
